items.title: Zelenskyi's generous ministerial changes: "Political jealousy"
items.summary: President Zelenskyi's rockades in Ukraine's leadership come close and unpredictably. Expert Ryhor Nizhnikau sees a dangerous trend. - There are two Zelenskys. One is the war hero, with great respect in the West and also within Ukraine. - But the other is a populist driven by simple election tactics.
items.summary_original: President Zelenskyjs rockader i Ukrainas ledning kommer tätt och oförutsägbart. Experten Ryhor Nizhnikau ser en farlig trend. – Det finns två Zelenskyj. Den ene är krigshjälten, med stor respekt i väst och även inom Ukraina. – Men den andre är en populist som drivs av simpel valtaktik.

items.title: Lina Hedlund alternates construction dust with disco glitter
items.summary: Artist Lina Hedlund is busy transforming an old house in Hälsingland into a dream home. But between the carpentry and the painting, she is preparing for the autumn's big tour: "It will be a folk festival."
items.title_original: Lina Hedlund varvar byggdamm med discoglitter
items.summary_original: Artisten Lina Hedlund har fullt upp med att förvandla ett gammalt hus i Hälsingland till ett drömboende. Men mellan snickrandet och målandet förbereder hon sig inför höstens stora turné: ”Det kommer att bli en folkfest.”

items.title: Infantino hits back at critics: 'Engaged in hate'
items.summary: The president of the international football association FIFA, Gianni Infantino, attacks all critics during the World Cup. In a 15-page long Instagram post, he accuses the critics of spreading hate and false rumours. "Sorry you were so absorbed in hate and criticism that you missed it all," he writes.
items.title_original: Infantino slår tillbaka mot kritikerna: ”Uppslukade av hat”
items.summary_original: Internationella fotbollsförbundet Fifas ordförande Gianni Infantino går till attack mot alla kritiker under fotbolls-VM. I ett 15 sidors långt Instagraminlägg anklagar han kritikerna för att sprida hat och falska rykten. ”Beklagar att ni var så uppslukade av hat och kritik så ni missade alltihop”, skriver han.

items.title: Sweden to contribute additional SEK 1.4 billion to World Bank operations in Ukraine
items.summary: The Government has today decided to provide SEK 1.4 billion in support to a new World Bank crisis facility that benefits Ukraine. This support enables new loans totalling approximately SEK 4.2 billion for the country’s reconstruction and recovery. The World Bank is a key actor for Ukraine’s reform efforts and economic resilience during Russia’s ongoing aggression. Sweden’s actions have been vital for the establishment of the new crisis facility.
